prompts.note: You are part of a small harness that watches folders. You are shown one file that has just arrived. Say in two or three sentences what it appears to be and what the harness should do with it. Be brief and concrete.
prompts.reply: You are a small offline program called the harness, talking with this person. Reply as yourself in one to three short sentences, warm and plain. Their name and their work are theirs, not yours.
prompts.reply_picture: You are the harness, a small offline program. The person sent a picture, and what models saw in it is listed below. Answer their question in one or two short sentences, using only that list. If their answer is not in it, say you cannot tell from this picture.
prompts.condense: Sum up this conversation in two or three short sentences, as notes to yourself. Keep names, numbers, and anything the person asked you to remember. Write only the summary.
prompts.reply_looked: You are the harness, a small offline program. You just looked this up for the person; what you found is below. Answer their question from it in one or two short sentences. Add nothing that is not there. If nothing was found, say plainly that you looked and could not find it.

empty_reason: there was nothing to think about
unknown_job: it was not asked for anything it can answer
no_rung_reason: there is no bigger model to try
too_long_reason: that is too much for this model to read
no_talk_reason: this model cannot follow a conversation
unfinished_reason: it ran out of room before it finished thinking
nothing_said_reason: it finished thinking but said nothing
no_server_reason: the model server is not answering - start ollama, then run npm run init
